# Spanish 06 — C2 precision, rhetoric, and mediation

Conceptual deck `deck:es-MX:06`. This implements [issue #21](https://github.com/25d-228/meiki-decks/issues/21), [Spanish plan #2](https://github.com/25d-228/meiki-decks/issues/2#stage-06) and [roadmap #1](https://github.com/25d-228/meiki-decks/issues/1), under the unchanged [pinned Spanish guide](https://github.com/25d-228/meiki-decks/blob/e1d8239b7560f26b092cc7bb97c005738b34361f/languages/es.md#67-proficient-integration). Exactly 1,600 original text cards, `es-06-0001`–`es-06-1600`, have one synchronized mapping each. All 40 ordinary author/editor pairs and the one exhaustive final editorial pass are complete. Editorial acceptance is distinct from ORCHESTRATOR project acceptance.

Verified starting main is `ff2e7ccfcc6ff2707c11420ec752a80a538aceab`, tree `2187e59a9ef523c943f70476a2ab6e65b578f4f3`, identical to the accepted Spanish 05 head's tree. Protect 21 files: ten accepted Spanish 01–05 source/coverage files, all nine language guides, `.gitignore` and `AGENTS.md`. Accepted Spanish remains 5/7 stages, 5,000/7,600 cards until ORCHESTRATOR acceptance; accepting 06 would bring 6,600. Spanish 07 remains 1,000 and unassigned; no later language/stage work is included.

## New hidden learning, breadth and primary decisions

The 1,600 mapped objectives extend the accepted 5,000 cards through new lexical forms, contextual senses, governed units and pragmatic contrasts. Visible support is distinguished from hidden retrieval; a word already inside an earlier cloze remains earlier hidden learning. New family members acknowledge their established shared function. Stored lemma, meaning-label and token statistics below do not establish distinct dictionary lexemes, unique senses, known vocabulary or proficiency.

Concrete ordinary-review overlap repairs include PUNZANTE in place of already hidden MORDAZ, LEGÍTIMA in place of NO POR ESO already represented by NO POR ELLO, and CONTRAARGUMENTAR in place of a known verb's ordinary inflection. FINGIDA replaces a planned FALSA MODESTIA target already present inside SIN FALSA MODESTIA. COPROTAGONISTA replaces a planned generic SECUNDARIO character label whose general meaning was already hidden. ANÁFORA at 0734 selects rhetorical repeated openings, explicitly distinguished from pronoun backward reference at 0268. The 0760 epigram's actual bell/silence contradiction replaces a draft that repeated 0495's brevity/verbosity case. Per-card mappings carry the precise final distinction and necessary support rather than counting a new topic or changed names as new learning.

Primary references resolve particular uncertainty; they do not certify every authored sentence. Dictionary examples, source quotations and canonical literary passages are not copied into production text. Failed reads, cache misses and unavailable entries are reported as such and do not establish a form's invalidity. Scholarly primary usage is distinguished from an explicit dictionary definition and from secondary quotation chains.

- Selected lexical senses and government retain their actual boundaries: [DLE desgana](https://dle.rae.es/desgana) supports the lack-of-inclination noun; [DPD azúcar](https://www.rae.es/dpd/az%C3%BAcar) permits both grammatical genders. Local case choices do not become universal gender or usage bans. The ENVIAR-type stress/conjugation decision for INVENTARÍA is preserved as exact-form support rather than a guessed written accent.
- [DPD tanto](https://www.rae.es/dpd/tanto) distinguishes the selected EN TANTO QUE adversative frame from the separate causal use. The modern logical TAUTOLOGÍA case uses its retained primary logic explanation rather than pretending the DLE rhetorical definition alone establishes that sense. CORRELATO uses the current noun rather than an obsolete adjective. Source, narrator, listener and beneficiary remain separate roles.
- [DLE punzante](https://dle.rae.es/punzante), [legítimo](https://dle.rae.es/leg%C3%ADtimo) and [contraargumentar](https://dle.rae.es/contraargumentar) support the selected sharp-critical, just/fair and counterarguing uses. Primary own critical usage resolves the PUNZANTE application; the failed DEM read is not claimed as support for LEGÍTIMA. The supplied counterarguing decision permits the selected intransitive use without inventing an all-transitivity prohibition.
- C cases supply actual incongruity, prior stance, interpretation or reported reaction. [DLE pelo](https://dle.rae.es/pelo), TOMAR EL PELO, supports the selected feigned-promise case; that is not automatically identical to humiliating dance mockery. [DLE puntada](https://dle.rae.es/puntada) supports the selected witty/pointed contribution; 0645's actual corrected context includes the prior dismissal and acknowledged disagreement rather than counting a topic reminder alone. Whole-span glosses retain visible negation and modality in their correct scope, including NO FUE PRECISAMENTE and EN TODO CASO's selected upper-bound use.
- [DLE narratario](https://dle.rae.es/narratario) supports the fiction-internal recipient character, distinct from an outside reader or beneficiary. [UNAM CCH focal knowledge](https://e1.portalacademico.cch.unam.mx/alumno/tlriid2/unidad4/autorynarrador/foconarrativo) and retained primary own literary use support the selected narrative knowledge cases; DLE omniscience's theological/general definitions alone are not falsely presented as a literary glossary. Grammatical person alone does not establish access to unspoken thoughts.
- [DLE diégesis](https://dle.rae.es/di%C3%A9gesis), [analepsis](https://dle.rae.es/analepsis), [prolepsis](https://dle.rae.es/prolepsis) and [monologar](https://dle.rae.es/monologar) retain their selected narrative development, temporal displacement and self-directed aloud speech senses. The cards do not import a film-sound taxonomy, equate a character's prediction with an actually narrated later scene, or treat all one-person meeting discourse as solitary self-address. Prefiguration remains an attributed correspondence rather than proof of causation or unestablished shared speaker identity.
- [DLE contrapunto](https://dle.rae.es/contrapunto) supports simultaneous contrast. Literary CONTRAPUNTÍSTICO uses actual own critical attestations by [Raquel Serur](https://debatefeminista.cieg.unam.mx/index.php/debate_feminista/article/download/900/801/1497) and [Juan Vadillo](https://repositorio.unam.mx/contenidos/ficha/el-paraiso-el-paisaje-y-la-lejania-en-america-de-kafka-4123809), rather than claiming that DLE's musical adjective definition explicitly verifies all literary usage. The original simultaneous voices and their actual differing stakes are supplied.
- [DLE conversión](https://dle.rae.es/conversi%C3%B3n) is the actually followed rhetorical cross-reference for EPÍFORA. [DLE anadiplosis](https://dle.rae.es/anadiplosis) supports the adjacent-clause hinge; [Nadine Ly's own analysis, p.81](https://cvc.cervantes.es/literatura/criticon/PDF/023/023_067.pdf) supports the selected EPANADIPLOSIS enclosing repetition. The latter distinction is not falsely attributed to DLE's broader cross-reference grouping, nor imposed on every rhetorical tradition.
- Literary PARALELÍSTICO is supported by [Armando López Castro's own scholarly usage](https://revistas-filologicas.unam.mx/medievalia/index.php/mv/article/view/386). DISFEMÍSTICO has [Germán Vanda Durante's own primary adjective usage, §4](https://cvc.cervantes.es/lengua/biblioteca_fraseologica/n5_durante/vanda_05.htm), while the denigrating-naming noun is separately verified in [DLE disfemismo](https://dle.rae.es/disfemismo). Unavailable direct adjective entries are not claimed as successful reads; no broader demographic, courtesy or historical assertions are imported.
- [DLE sinécdoque](https://dle.rae.es/sin%C3%A9cdoque) permits related metonymic classification rather than a universal exclusion rule. [Apóstrofe](https://dle.rae.es/ap%C3%B3strofe) is the selected vehement address, distinct from APÓSTROFO punctuation; [hipálage](https://dle.rae.es/hip%C3%A1lage) has actual modifier transfer; [zeugma](https://dle.rae.es/zeugma) has the selected shared predicate's different semantic applications. Generic omission alone is not labeled ZEUGMA. [Clímax](https://dle.rae.es/cl%C3%ADmax) and [anticlímax](https://dle.rae.es/anticl%C3%ADmax) retain local peak and subsequent drop: an unopened envelope does not prove it contains the sought explanation.

- Literary form and diction (0761–0800): DLE/actual cross-references distinguish elegy and lamenting tone, ode, poetic line/stanza, meter/rhyme, prose form versus poetic quality, lyric adjective versus substantive genre, and nostalgia/recall. Original metric and rhyme cases were checked from their visible words; these are text analyses without audio verification. H primary-reference scope (actual reviewed H ranges/process counts are recorded separately). Selected DLE senses distinguish consensus among all named participants; accommodation despite retained preferences; compatible contributions; a cooperante attitude from the separate international-aid worker noun; persuadable claims from a person's openness; fascination/enthusiasm from hypnosis or domination; prudent free choice from arbitrariness; excuse/blame release from a duty release; debt forgiveness from arbitrary exemption; and a lighter substituted obligation from judicial or electrical meanings. Derived lexical forms acknowledge known functions, rather than count ordinary tense, person or gender changes as new learning. Concrete source exchanges must establish audience, authority, concession, conditions, beneficiary and remaining choices. Actual causal reconciliar is distinguished from the earlier pronominal se reconciliaron, while successful reconciliador/apaciguador descriptions require the stated relevant result. Clientelismo is the political favor-for-loyalty practice in expressly fictional local electoral material, and compadrazgo through compadraje is mutual, rather than a one-way favor. Nepotismo follows the actual role/family-or-friend/merit definition without inventing a public-office-only restriction or legal conclusion.

Neither the full paper, author identity, theory nor cited Fogelin original is claimed read. The full earlier inconciliable record and the new case's explicitly incompatible conditions supply the application. DLE circunspección itself uses comedidamente, with comedido's prudent/moderate base followed; no separate adverb entry is invented.

Bilateralidad is attested in CENOC's own negotiation/dialogue explanation at https://www.argentina.gob.ar/sites/default/files/8.7estrategias_de_captacion_de_fondos_publicos_privados_y_de_la_cooperacion_internacional.pdf, and multilateralidad in the participant's own UN Colombia cooperation account at https://colombia.un.org/es/272025-colombia-y-naciones-unidas-firmaron-el-nuevo-marco-de-cooperaci%C3%B3n-para-el-desarrollo. Together with the followed general DLE bilateral/multilateral senses, these are bounded lexical evidence for two/several parties, not treaty, donor-policy or political-theory verification. The Mexican SCJN's own unilateralmente usage at https://www.internet2.scjn.gob.mx/red2/comunicados/comunicado.asp?id=8333 is used only for one-party action; no legal entitlement or current-law advice is borrowed. DLE American interinato supplies the interim-role period; Mexican UNAM usage at https://tesiunamdocumentos.dgb.unam.mx/pd2008/0628028/0628028.pdf is lexical corroboration, without claiming to have read its quoted Omeba/Acosta originals.

Mexican UNAM analytical prose at https://tesiunamdocumentos.dgb.unam.mx/pd2005/0602173/0602173.pdf, page129, uses serenamente for calm conversation. That own lexical attestation and the followed sereno calm sense support the adverb; no film viewing, listening or prosody analysis occurred. ## Editorial scope and actual process

All 1,600 situations are original authored text. Primary sources resolve uncertain form, sense, government, register and orthography; their examples and canonical literary passages are not copied. Failed reads are not verification, and a missing entry is not a grammar ban. Grammatical terminology and new family members do not receive credit as first exposure to a shared established function. Every card hides one meaningful compact contiguous unit; the gloss, lemma, grammatical label and useful support describe that actual unit. Logical audio paths are checked without MP3 files.

Ordinary review used 40 consecutive batches of 40, one fresh author and separate fresh editor each. EXECUTOR read every complete output, resolved actual findings and alone saved source/coverage. Every author, editor and final reviewer uses the unchanged authorized CLI 0.163.0 exact `gpt-6.1-sol`, high reasoning, fresh `--ephemeral`, read-only sandbox and structured JSON, sequentially without session reuse, nested agents, child edits or fallback. Verified plugin, Firecrawl MCP-server and plugins-feature disabling plus invocation isolation preceded the first and every subsequent launch. No Firecrawl startup/use or permission request occurred. Scratch prompts, outputs, references, logs and caches remain executor-local `/tmp/meiki-decks-es-06/`.

Process exceptions and root adjudications are retained honestly in PR evidence. Batch25 author and editor each first encountered an actual CLI/wrapper1 model-capacity failure with no completed content output; both failed event streams and unchanged inputs were retained, and fresh retries used the same authorized model/settings. No completed authoring/review was repeated and no model fallback occurred. Ordinary editor 01 completed with CLI/wrapper 0 and one nonfatal model-catalog refresh timeout on stderr; no fallback/retry/probe/settings change followed. Actual individual CLI status, wrapper status, completion events, distinct threads and child tool events are separate evidence, not inferred from JSON output. Ordinary 03's case-mismatched prerequisite and 11's incorrect source ID were repaired after frozen editor inputs; root read the full correct earlier records and the final pass receives those complete records. Root's localized 0645 source/map disagreement-context correction occurred after its ordinary editor input was frozen; exact corrected wording is covered by the final pass, not falsely attributed to that frozen input. Root replaced1425's ordinary-editor scarf-material lie (repeating0065) with a distinct admitted false childcare-assignment excuse for declining an invitation, preserving GUAYABA and synchronizing support/map; the actual saved root-new case is supplied to the single final pass, not falsely claimed reviewed in its frozen ordinary input. Other root scope corrections and actual model findings remain in the local resolution record. Before the first dispatch of pending final21, an actual reference check distinguished old03-0903 hidden CONVIVIMOS from its visible/glossed PLATICAMOS. That complete earlier record and a bounded clarification were added, replacing its redundant inventory-only representation; all target source/mapping fields, ranges and other34 prompts stayed unchanged. The revised prompt was locally remeasured at981,309 characters/UTF16 units with82 FULL earlier records. The same first final21 call corrected1071 to credit known visible exposure and first direct hidden verb retrieval; no completed partition or model call was repeated.
